changelog:
DLNA Renderer, Screen Color Filter, HA STT/TTS, BLE ADV Proxy & Video Call Quality.

DLNA Renderer: Ava acts as DLNA/UPnP renderer for music and device-decodable video. Path: Settings → Experimental → Mod Store. Thanks @303inmyheart #93. Headless by default; enable Cinema in mod config for video UI. Competes with Sendspin for audio focus—use one at a time. Earpiece output requires HAL support.

Screen Color Filter: Control screen tint and opacity from HA. Supports off/red/blue/dark/yellow/green/gray. Path: Settings → Experimental → Mod Store.

HA STT Engine: Local offline Wyoming STT on port 10300. Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese. First run downloads ~230MB SenseVoice model. Path: Settings → Experimental → Mod Store.

HA Edge TTS: Wyoming TTS on port 10301 using Edge TTS voices. Supports multiple languages, voice, speed, volume, pitch. Path: Settings → Experimental → Mod Store.

BLE ADV Proxy: Replicates ESP32 ble_adv_proxy functionality. Works with ha-ble-adv. Enable separate switch in Ava Bluetooth settings after install. Path: Settings → Experimental → Mod Store. Thanks @realroywalker #96.

Video calls: Smooth/HD/Ultra HD quality modes added.

Fixes: Bluetooth device add crashes, wrong unknown device icons, RSSI threshold/ringtone preview UX. Camera display and rotation #92 @cw20081. AEC/playback reference on Portal-like devices #91 @realroywalker. Sendspin MA controller delta state, repeat/shuffle, group volume, mute, seek, stop sync #95 @vexter0944. Faster main screen init, smoother loading.
